*Database Migration Script
-> migrate -database postgres://postgres:password@localhost:5432/db_social_service?sslmode=disable -path external/database/migrations up/down

** When you are using docker
migrate -path ./external/database/migrations -database "postgres://postgres:password@localhost:5432/db_social_service?sslmode=disable" up


*Database Create Migration
-> migrate create -ext sql -dir external/database/migrations migration-name
